title: Lifting Operations Risk Assessment
description: Free Lifting Operations Risk Assessment template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers lifting operation information, lift categorization, lifting operations risk assessment matrix.
standard: API RP 2D - ASME B30 Series - LOLER (UK)

Lift Categorization

LIFT CLASSIFICATION:

☐ ROUTINE LIFT - Standard lift within normal operating parameters, not exceeding 80% of crane capacity, no special hazards, no lifts over live equipment or personnel.
☐ CRITICAL LIFT - Any lift meeting ONE OR MORE of these criteria:
☐ Lift > 80% of crane rated capacity
☐ Lift over live equipment/process areas
☐ Lift over occupied facilities
☐ Multiple crane lift
☐ Lift of personnel (manbasket/manriding)
☐ Lift in high wind or restricted visibility
☐ Unusual or complex rigging arrangement
☐ Lift of hazardous materials
☐ Lift in environmentally sensitive area
☐ First use of new lift procedure/equipment
☐ ENGINEERED LIFT - Exceeding 100% of crane rated capacity or requiring engineering analysis. Requires engineered lift plan and PE stamp.

THIS LIFT IS CLASSIFIED AS: ☐ ROUTINE ☐ CRITICAL ☐ ENGINEERED

IF CRITICAL OR ENGINEERED, A WRITTEN LIFT PLAN IS REQUIRED AND ATTACHED.

LIFT PLAN #: ______________ ATTACHED: Yes ☐ No ☐

DURING LIFT:

☐ Lift smoothly - No sudden movements

☐ Tag lines used to control load
☐ Constant communication maintained
☐ Load watched for shifting
☐ Personnel stay clear of load and swing radius

AFTER LIFT:

☐ Crane secured (boom down, parking brake set)
☐ Area returned to normal
☐ Post-lift debrief conducted (if needed)
☐ Lift documented (if critical/engineered)
